product.olivetti-echos-p90.summary: The Echos P90 in the Italian Pentium line with a 10.4-inch display.
product.olivetti-echos-p90.history: MCmicrocomputer documented the Echos P90 in December 1995 in Olivetti’s multimedia Echos P line. It listed an Italian price of 7,900,000 lire excluding VAT.
product.olivetti-echos-p90.architecture: The display defined this configuration. The Italian listing specifies TFT · 10.4″ and a 810 MB disk.
product.olivetti-echos-p90.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p90.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
